speaker: Quentin L. Cook
role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
title: Integrity and Virtue Lead to Happiness
summary: Elder Cook teaches that integrity and virtue are tied to true happiness and keep disciples on the covenant path, and he warns against the coarse, crude conduct common in society and online. He tells of a carved stone in Scotland reading “Whate’er thou art, act well thy part” that shaped the young missionary David O. McKay, and of a World War II sailor he taught who compared repentance to stepping onto home soil. He asks members to live with integrity, be peacemakers, spend time every day in the scriptures, and make repentance part of daily life.
